findings_summary.finding: There is no matched target-Triton no-speculation control, so the selected timing population is a whole-recipe result and cannot isolate MTP speedup.
findings_summary.concrete_input_or_state: The compared lanes vary attention backend, speculation, KV settings, graph behavior, and for the selected lane configured maximum context.
findings_summary.wrong_result_if_ignored: A reader could attribute the measured decode difference to MTP alone.
findings_summary.disposition: Adequately disclosed; no additional sweep is required for the bounded selected-profile claim.

findings_summary.finding: The qualification is C1 and bounded: it does not measure C2, a literal 32768-token input, SWE work, video, long-duration soak, or a general quality ranking.
findings_summary.concrete_input_or_state: The largest observed prompts were 29578-29629 tokens with a 2048-token total completion cap; agentic evidence contains two synthetic cases; telemetry uses five-second sampling and observed 3342 MiB minimum free memory for the selected profile.
findings_summary.wrong_result_if_ignored: The evidence could be generalized beyond the concurrency, context, workload, stability, and modality actually tested.
findings_summary.disposition: Adequately disclosed and acceptable for the stated 32K/C1 direct qualification.
